author: Make Something
description:
Struggling with the post-success crash and finding my rhythm again. Brought to us by Squarespace. Go to http://squarespace.com/makesomething to save 10% oﬀ your first purchase of a website or domain using code MAKESOMETHING.

I just wrapped up my first solo art show, and it was everything I hoped for: people showed up, I sold more than expected, I even made the front page of the newspaper. And then it was over, and instead of feeling amazing, I felt flat. So I went back to where I started as a woodworker: building a simple keepsake box, no plans, no decisions, just something to hold the memories from the show while I try to find my way back into making art again.
